summary.text: Stephen Hawley is a Republican member of the New York State Assembly representing District 139, an office he has held since 2006, and is seeking re-election on the Republican and Conservative Party lines in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Hawley earned a B.S. in education from the University of Toledo.
His professional experience includes co-owning The Insurance Center, owning and operating Hawley Farms, and working as a real estate agent.
He served as a First Lieutenant in the United States Army Reserve and in the Ohio Army National Guard, and he has served as a member of the Genesee County Legislature.
For the 2025-2026 session, Hawley was assigned to the Agriculture, Insurance, Rules, Veterans' Affairs and Ways and Means committees.
